title: The part of the Christmas truce nobody talks about… enemies buried their dead together 🕯️
caption:
The part of the Christmas truce nobody talks about… enemies buried their dead together 🕯️ Christmas Day 1914, a true story.

Can shared loss end even the oldest feud? Tell us in the comments 👇

There are no front lines at a graveside. There are only people who have lost someone.

"The First to Stand Up" – the whole true story as a book.

slides.text: First, they buried their dead. Together.
Christmas Day 1914. Both sides agreed to bring in the dead.
Germans and Scots carried each other's dead to the same place.
Psalm 23 was read. Once in English, once in German.
There are no front lines at a graveside. Only people who have lost someone.
Can shared loss end even the oldest feud?

firstComment: Did you know this part of the story? 👀
